subject: Vendor enrollment: PO requirements & multicurrency remittance
messages:
From: Sofia Kline <sofia.k@rowan-retail.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ap@rowan-retail.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Vendor registration: Redwood Inference – PO and remittance requirements

Hi Irene / Laura,

Thanks for engaging with Rowan Procurement. To get Redwood set up in our supplier master and to ensure invoices flow cleanly through our AP, we need the following from your side before we can process POs: 

- Legal entity name and registered address to match bank account on file.
- Tax/VAT registration evidence (EU VAT certificate or equivalent) — file must include VAT ID and effective date.
- Bank remittance details: IBAN (for EUR/GBP where applicable), SWIFT/BIC, and account holder name.
- Preferred invoice currency (we accept GBP / EUR / USD) — invoices must match PO currency.
- Standard PO fields required on every invoice: Rowan PO number, line-level PO item code, unit price, quantity, and VAT amount per line.
- For invoice amounts over £50,000 we require procurement sign-off and the PO will include a "threshold approval" flag.
- Payment terms: standard Net30; early payment program available separately (please indicate if you want to enroll).
- Attachment: Please upload a sample invoice (PDF) showing line-level billing and a completed vendor enrollment form.

We also have a supplier portal where you can create your vendor account: https://suppliers.rowan-retail.com/enroll (Portal ID: rowan-supplier-portal/12345). 

Attached is our AP packet template to speed things up. Return the completed template and the VAT/bank evidence and we should be able to issue the first PO within 4–6 business days.

Sofia
Sofia Kline
Accounts Payable 
Rowan Retail

Attachment: rowan_ap_packet_template.xlsx (AP enrollment template, required fields highlighted)

From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Kline <sofia.k@rowan-retail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration: Redwood Inference – PO and remittance requirements

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you requested, and we have a couple of quick clarifying questions before we populate the portal fields: 

1) Self-bill: does Rowan allow self-billed invoices for new suppliers as a one-time pilot, or do you require supplier-submitted invoices for all first-time invoices?
2) VAT handling: for EU customers where reverse-charge might apply, should we leave VAT lines blank and include a note referencing the reverse-charge article, or do you prefer a zero-VAT line followed by a comment?
3) PO splitting: if a single PO covers multiple shipments (milestones), should we submit one consolidated invoice referencing each shipment as separate line items, or submit separate invoices per shipment?

We're attaching our vendor enrollment checklist and a redacted copy of our bank details for the portal (IBAN + SWIFT). We'll complete the portal upload as soon as you confirm the self-bill and VAT preferences.

Appreciate it — aiming to have everything into your portal tomorrow.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Enrollment-Checklist.pdf; Redwood-Bank-Details-IBAN.pdf

From: Sofia Kline <sofia.k@rowan-retail.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ap@rowan-retail.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor registration: Redwood Inference – PO and remittance requirements

Hi Irene — quick answers below: 

1) Self-bill: We typically require supplier-submitted invoices for onboarding. Self-billing can be approved but only after a 30-day review and a signed MOU — not available for initial POs.
2) VAT handling: Please show VAT line as whatever applies. If reverse-charge applies, include the VAT amount as "0.00" and add the standard reverse-charge note: "VAT reversed — recipient liable under EU Art. 44" and include your VAT ID on each invoice.
3) PO splitting: If the PO explicitly lists multiple milestone lines, a single invoice with separate line items is fine; otherwise submit separate invoices per shipment and reference the PO number on each invoice.

Currency: We will honor the PO currency. For GBP/EUR payments we prefer SEPA/IBAN transfers; for USD we use ACH/Wire. Please confirm whether Redwood wants invoices to be in the invoice currency or if you want us to provide a VAT-converted PO option (we can but it requires an additional field in the portal).

Portal note: after you upload the enrollment packet, allow 48 hours for validation. Once validated we will open the supplier account and issue the PO.

Thanks,
Sofia

Attachment: none

From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Redwood next steps for Rowan vendor onboarding (internal)

Laura / Marcus — summary and action items after Rowan's confirmation: 

- Portal enrollment: Laura to upload the completed AP template + VAT certificate + IBAN PDF into Rowan portal (rowan-supplier-portal/12345). Estimated validation 48h after upload.
- Invoicing format: Use single invoice with line-level PO items for milestone POs; include VAT lines per Rowan guidance and add reverse-charge note when applicable.
- Currency handling: We will invoice in the PO currency. Marcus to confirm bank configuration for EUR/GBP payouts; ensure our bank account accepts SEPA GBP/EUR and that payment instructions include SWIFT for non-SEPA wires.
- Thresholds: For invoices > £50k mark "threshold approval" field in portal and provide procurement contact (I will add contact info in the portal comments).
- Self-bill: Not available for initial invoices — defer until after 30-day review.

Action items due: Laura (upload) by EOD Mon 7 Dec 2026; Marcus (bank config) by Tue 8 Dec 2026. I will follow up with Rowan AP after upload to confirm they have what they need and to request the PO issuance timeline.

Thanks — keeping this tight so we can get our first invoice processed without payment delays.

Irene
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
